## Tools exposed by the server

`check_fx_mid_market_rate`
Returns the live mid-market rate for a currency pair plus its inverse — built-in inversion guard for AI agents.

`audit_fx_transaction`
Scores a single FX transaction 0-10. Returns spread in basis points, hidden fee in CAD/USD, and a verdict.

`full_forensic_fx_report`
Generates a complete signed forensic report with SHA256 audit trail. Requires a Bearer API token.

`compare_fx_sources`
Side-by-side comparison of mid-market, your bank rate and PSP-rail quotes. Identifies the cheapest path per $100K notional.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is the iPayX MCP server?

iPayX exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI agents like Claude, Cursor, Perplexity and ChatGPT call forensic FX audit tools in real time. iPayX Protocol detects hidden bank markup on any FX transaction by comparing the bank's applied rate to the live mid-market rate at the timestamp of execution.

### Which AI clients support the iPayX MCP server?

Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot Studio, ChatGPT (Custom GPT actions), Smithery, Zapier, n8n, and any other client compatible with MCP Streamable HTTP or OpenAPI 3.1.

### Is the iPayX MCP server free to use?

The public read tools (live mid-market rate lookup, single transaction audit) are free with per-IP rate limiting. The full forensic report tool requires a Bearer API token from the iPayX dashboard.

### What tools does the MCP server expose?

check_fx_mid_market_rate (live rate with auto-inversion safety), audit_fx_transaction (0-10 forensic score with spread in basis points), full_forensic_fx_report (signed PDF with SHA256 audit trail), and compare_fx_sources (side-by-side rate comparison).

### Is iPayX FINTRAC registered?

Yes. iPayX is registered with FINTRAC as a Money Services Business under license number C10001283 and operates under PIPEDA-aligned data handling.
